title: Risk factors and socio-economic burden in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma operation: a machine learning based analysis
summary: Retrospective databases include 1,242 patients, with a 660-patient complete-variable cohort used to model ICU admission and socioeconomic burden.
ai_technology: Machine-learning risk analysis identifies factors associated with ICU admission and short-term outcomes after pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma surgery.
organization: Renji Hospital; School of Medicine; Shanghai Jiaotong University

evidence.tested: Retrospective databases include 1,242 patients, with a 660-patient complete-variable cohort used to model ICU admission and socioeconomic burden.
evidence.unknown: Database selection and missingness constrain interpretation; risk associations are not causal. The source does not establish benefits beyond the reported evaluation.
evidence.ai_role: Machine-learning risk analysis identifies factors associated with ICU admission and short-term outcomes after pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma surgery.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
